description: This file defines the IAsyncObserver interface in the Orleans.Streams namespace, which generalizes the .NET IObserver interface to support asynchronous stream processing, including methods for handling new items, stream completion, and errors.

classes.name: IAsyncObserver<in T>
classes.description: An interface for asynchronous observation of stream items, allowing consumers to process items, handle stream completion, and errors asynchronously.

methods.name: OnNextAsync
methods.description: Handles the arrival of a new item in the stream, returning a Task that completes when the item has been accepted.

methods.name: OnCompletedAsync
methods.description: Notifies the observer that the stream has completed; returns a Task that completes when the notification has been processed.

methods.name: OnErrorAsync
methods.description: Notifies the observer of an error in the stream; returns a Task that completes when the error has been processed.
